KIMPSON'S TABLE

Home-style Korean Food

Kimpson's Table



Operating hours: 
Tue to Sun: 11:30am – 2:30pm & 5:00 pm – 10pm (Last Order at 9:30pm) 
Mon: Closed

Our 11th chef at Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central is Kimpson's Table, operating from 16 January to 13 March 2026. We spoke to founder, Patrick Kim, to find out more about his journey. 

Originally a semiconductor engineering major, Patrick traded silicon wafers for sauté pans after discovering a deep-seated passion for the culinary arts. After honing his skills in Italian and Japanese kitchens and later serving as a head chef in Singapore, he is now using the Chef X platform to bring his most personal project to life. 

Kimpson’s Table was born from a singular, heartfelt mission: to provide the comforting, "mother’s home-cooked" experience that many Koreans living abroad—and locals alike—deeply crave. Inspired by the banchan (side dish) delivery culture of Korea, the menu is designed to offer wholesome, healthy meals that does not compromise on flavour. 

Every dish is a tribute to family. By blending professional expertise with recipes passed down from his mother and grandmother, Patrick ensures that every bite feels less like a transaction and more like an invitation into his home. All dishes are low-sodium, low-sugar, and made entirely in-house. 

Being a part of Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central 


For Patrick, this residency is more than just a pop-up; it is a vital proving ground. Having spent a decade managing and leading kitchens, he is using the space at Chef X to test his concept in a physical retail setting. 
"This platform allows me to see how customers respond to Kimpson’s Table in a physical space," he shares. "Our goal is to use this two-month experience to prepare for the opening of our very own offline store." 

 

Specially curated for Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central 


The curated menu at Chef X is headlined by the Authentic Ginseng Chicken Set (Samgyetang), served with nourishing soup, rice, and three side dishes. For those seeking classic comforts can tuck into hearty Beef and Spicy Pork Bulgogi Sets or savour the regional special of the ChunCheon Style Spicy Chicken Set. 

These mains are perfectly complemented by a selection of handcrafted sides, including Kimchi Pancake, Deep Fried Dumpling, and Boneless Chicken available in Original, Bburringkle Cheese, or Sweet & Spicy seasoning. 
To complete the experience, guests can enjoy traditional Korean soft drinks like Sik-hye and Bong-bong Grape Juice or opt for Soju and Beer. 
Check out the full menu here. 

About Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central

 

Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central is an initiative by Far East Organization that provides home-based chefs and private dining chefs with a sandbox to operate their own full-fledged commercial restaurant within Clarke Quay Central mall for four or eight weeks. From 26 April 2024, each resident chef will serve out of a professionally designed F&B space fitted with commercial-grade kitchen equipment, with a dining area that can accommodate up to 24 diners.

Apart from physical resources, resident chefs will be offered guidance. They can look forward to receiving advice and tips - from menu planning, food presentation and recipe refinements, to business and human resource management, from Chef Isaac Tan, Head of Culinary & Product Innovations for Commonwealth Concepts (CWC), the F&B joint venture between Commonwealth Capital and Far East Organization. An industry veteran who has led dining institutions such as Bedrock Bar & Grill since its inception in 2008, Chef Isaac Tan currently steers 12 distinct brands under the group, including Fat Cow, Kinki Restaurant + Bar, and The Marmalade Pantry.

Each resident chef, who will helm the restaurant for four or eight weeks, will showcase their culinary skills and individual styles, cooking at the unit for dine-in customers, with the option of takeaway.

Head down to Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central #03-103 today.
